charts.title: TrES-1 b: orbits around TrES-1
charts.description: The orbits of TrES-1's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TrES-1 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 3.030069476 d

charts.title: TrES-1 b: dayside emission
charts.description: TrES-1 b's dayside emission: the light lost as the planet passes behind its star: its day side's own glow and reflected light. 4 measured bins from Cubillos et al. 2014 (Spitzer Space Telescope satellite, Infrared Array Camera (IRAC)), as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them. Horizontal bars are wavelength bins; vertical bars are the published 1-sigma errors.
notes: Spitzer Space Telescope satellite, Infrared Array C…
Values as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them.

charts.title: TrES-1 b: its transit
charts.description: TrES-1 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (74, 80, 81) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 120757718, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
